intentionalIslands.name: Tom Sawyer Island
intentionalIslands.note: Reachable only by raft; not an error that it is disconnected from the mainland walk component. Seed = Fort Wilderness (mid-island); the Pirate's Lair POI pin sits at the raft dock on the mainland bank, so it is NOT a valid island seed.
intentionalIslands.entranceNote: Raft dock on the mainland bank (the Pirate's Lair pin); on-island POIs get entrance overrides here so navigation walks users to the rafts.
